title: 483 comment sentences over 40 words across 60 of 74 tooling files
claim: Counting prose paragraphs only (usage, code, list and table lines excluded), the D5 units of the D5-s5 cells hold 483 sentences over 40 words, in 60 of the 74 files.
mechanism: Fails D5-criteria.md C5 (easy to understand: no sentence over 40 words). The instruments' WHY blocks chain clauses with dashes, parentheses and semicolons into one sentence. A hand sample of 10 strict hits (taken before the table-row and `$`-split refinement, which only removed hits) read 9 as genuine prose sentences over 40 words, the tenth a threshold table; the raw splitter count is 743. Worst files: prepr.sh 111, merge_train.py 64, bus.sh 42, app_approve.sh 41, cloud_relay.sh 27.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, finder fan-out running; a count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: the comment and docstring units of tools/audit/seat/{a..o}*, tools/audit/seat/hooks/** and tools/pr/** via text_ledger.units_of

perturbation.change: --edit 'tools/pr/push.sh|push rather than after it, and the QUERY arm refuses the same way.|push rather than after it. The QUERY arm refuses the same way.' (one 42-word sentence split; the count moves down by one)

metric_definition: count of comment/docstring sentences over 40 words in the cells' D5 units, prose paragraphs only (RESULT long_sentences_strict)
phenomenon_property: No comment or docstring sentence in the cells exceeds 40 words.
proposed_fix_scope: Split long sentences in the WHY blocks, worst files first (prepr.sh, merge_train.py, bus.sh, app_approve.sh); no code change.
reproduction_steps: perturb: --edit 'tools/pr/push.sh|push rather than after it, and the QUERY arm refuses the same way.|push rather than after it. The QUERY arm refuses the same way.' (one 42-word sentence split; the count moves down by one)

null_control.note: a docstring whose 54-word raw hit is two sentences joined at `$HPO_STATE_DIR` counts 0 strict: the splitter artefact is not counted
